thread:
maya: quick update from today's lightweight speculative run on ozma-13b-q4 (microbench v2) — paste of highlights below
jon: cool, which harness and config?
maya: bench-v2, warmup=25, seq=512, batch=1, speculative_prefetch=0.55, seeds=5, trace-level=token
sasha: what quality checks did you run?
maya: ppl on heldout, exact-match on a 150-item trivia set, BERTScore on 250 summarization prompts, plus a tiny fluency ngram detector and manual skim for hallucinations
leo: give raw numbers pls
maya: median per-token latency: 20.8ms -> 15.1ms (1.38x speedup). p99: 82ms -> 44ms. tail improved most when speculative threshold ~0.55
anita: any notable regressions?
maya: small downward delta: BERTScore -0.6, trivia EM -0.7%. Regressions concentrated on prompts >420 tokens and on code completion continuity in a few examples
jon: command exact?
maya: ```
./bench.py --model ozma-13b-q4 --mode speculative --harness microbench-v2 --warmup 25 --seq 512 --batch 1 --spec_prefetch 0.55 --seeds 5 --out s3://bench/micro-1777654321.json\```
infra-bot: bench job completed: infra/job/bench/1777654321 status: SUCCESS. artifacts: s3://bench/micro-1777654321.json, s3://logs/micro-1777654321-traces.tar.gz
sasha: did you sweep the prefetch threshold tradeoff? curious about misprediction cost vs saved KV loads
maya: yes, ran grid [0.0,0.25,0.45,0.55,0.75]. 0.0 minimized quality hits but had worst p99; 0.55 and 0.45 balanced latency and minimal EM loss. 0.75 had more spec mistakes causing clarity issues in long summaries
leo: how do you detect hallucination-ish outputs automatically? any heuristic?
maya: token surprisal spike + semantic-drift metric (cosine drift of embedding window) + repetition rate. example flag: "prompt_1983 drift=0.42 surprisal_peak=28"
jon: rollout suggestion?
maya: shadow 48h @2% to collect diverse usage, then canary 3-stage: 3% -> 15% -> 40% with auto-rollback on >1% EM drop on trivia holdouts or >1.5 BERTScore drop on summarization
anita: add targeted holdouts: long-context summarization, small codegen snippets (100 examples), and instruction-following edgecases
ops-bot: ticket INF-4628 created for canary + eval hooks (owner: maya)
maya: next steps: (1) expand holdout set to 2k prompts covering long/short summaries, codegen, instructions; (2) repeat runs across 3 seeds and 2 quant variants; (3) run full-throughput on 8xA100 dedicated nodes to validate tail under load; (4) wire per-prompt delta export into eval board
sasha: include per-prompt CSVs and raw traces. we'll triage worst-offenders and maybe apply prompt-specific fallback rules
jon: also add a lightweight grammar/fluency check for summarization to catch phrasing drift
leo: +1 on a 24h shadow at 2% before any canary ramp. real-world traffic finds weird cases
anita: also monitor token entropy and repetition rate, add alerts for entropy collapse
maya: scheduling shadow 48h @2% (will attach plan to INF-4628). PR with summary + artifacts coming shortly
jon: thanks - useful and actionable. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://bench/micro-1777654321.json and s3://logs/micro-1777654321-traces.tar.gz
ops-bot: calendar invite created: "Speculative run triage" tomorrow 10:00 PT (guests: maya, jon, sasha, leo, anita)
maya: will ping when PR is ready and drop CSVs on the eval board
